description: This file defines the ActiveMQNotificationEventPublisher class, which implements the NotificationEventPublisher interface to send notification data to an ActiveMQ queue named 'NotificationQueue'. It uses Spring annotations for conditional component inclusion and dependency injection of JmsTemplate.

classes.name: ActiveMQNotificationEventPublisher
classes.description: A Spring service class that publishes notification events to an ActiveMQ queue.

methods.name: broadcastNotification
methods.description: Method to send NotificationData to the 'NotificationQueue' via JMS.
